Name: Grim Transmogrification
Description: Choose one creature within the spell’s range. You attempt to replicate a part of a target’s body, such as a claw, head, tail, or other aspect of their body that naturally exists, and is not a manufactured extension or piece of equipment. This piece of their body must be part of a weapon attack listed on their stat block. Once you have chosen a piece of the target, you must succeed a spellcasting ability check, with a DC of 10 + half the CR (or total level) of the target, and may add the level you cast this spell at to your check. If you succeed, one of your limbs is replaced by the selected body part, and you are able to use it with the same reach and damage, and the same effects (at the GM’s discretion) as described on its stat block. You may use the copied body part to make a weapon attack in place of one of your weapon attacks each turn (or once per Attack action taken on your turn). You must use your spellcasting ability in place of Strength or Dexterity to determine its attack and damage bonuses, and use your spell save DC for any saving throws associated with the body part. When you replace a limb with the targeted body part, you lose whatever function that body part would grant you. If you replace an arm it cannot be used to wield weapons or shields, or to manipulate items. If you select a leg, your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet (or by 5 feet if you have at least two legs remaining). You can choose to end this effect early as an action, reverting your limb(s) back to their original forms. You may only copy a given body part once at a time, but may cast this spell multiple times to transform multiple limbs.
